purpose: Versioned repair of the supplemental audit-only Medusa/Foundry full-system randomized accounting state machine for cyvlSDT v30. V1 and V2 remain immutable failed execution evidence. V3 intentionally uses interface-valid audit-only fee distributors plus a controlled fake StakeDAO router to simulate vlSDT fee generation while exercising the exact production Locker claim/accounting path. Frozen production source remains unchanged.
technicalLimitations: StakeDAO fee accrual and aggregate-router correctness are intentionally not claimed by this harness. V3 simulates their resulting reward balance delta with audit-only dependencies that satisfy the production Locker fee-distributor identity contract.

CurveYieldGovernanceStaking.vy is excluded from the Solidity Medusa/Foundry overlay because the accepted mixed-language runner compiles Vyper separately and crytic-compile source-map handling is not compatible with importing that Vyper target into this Solidity state machine. Its accounting lifecycle is separately exercised on real pinned Anvil in Phase 7.
This Phase-6 randomized harness is not live Phase-7 mutable-RPC simulation evidence and does not substitute for deployment-first Anvil lifecycle testing of the exact audited contracts.
